text: First look: a tiny floating island in the sea with a tomato plot, a tree, and a little white bunny-like creature. Day 2, 14/30 sec, coins 10, Lv1 0/95. Prompt says 'Tap the ripe crop'. Going to tap the tomatoes.

Harvest gave +3 coins and XP. Days are only 30 seconds - day/night flips very quickly. The bunny is called a Momo. Now it wants me to tap a pencil to pick tiles the Momo looks after. The tutorial panel overlaps the Momo panel a bit.
Assigned the farm tile (shows a '1' badge). 1/4 tiles. Momo now 'Working at Farm'. Only one building exists so I'll confirm with the checkmark.
Momo is now farming on its own - 6 jobs done, coins 19, +$9/min. A letter bubble above Momo and a red dot on Mailbox. Curious - opening the mailbox.
Charming letter from Momo proposing 'Field expansion' research. Coins climbing (+$18/min). Pressing Let's research it.
Research tree! Tabs: Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games, Ca... Field expansion needs 3 flasks + $20 and 20s. Seems I need a research lab first. Tapping 'Build a research lab'.
Build menu opened: Farm $10, Mine (Lv3), Lumberyard (Lv2), Research lab (Lv2), Special 0/1. Lab is locked until Lv2 - I'm at 50/95. I have $40 so I'll build a second farm.
Farm got placed on the right tile automatically - I didn't pick a spot, it just went there. Building, 2 sec. The island looks like 2x2 tiles. New mail again.
Oops - the second farm replaced the tree. Didn't expect that. Momo seems to have gone to work the new farm on its own (Farm 1/1). Second letter: Watering efficiency. Accepting it.
Level 2! $60. The second farm sits ripe - Momo only works the first. Harvesting it by hand.
Tapped the empty grass tile and the build menu popped. Research lab now $40, Lumberyard $80. Building the lab on this empty tile.
Lab is building on the left tile. New hint: 'Tap the glowing sea to grow the island' - a dashed square in the water, $30. I have $41. Expanding!
Island grew - new tile with a bush appeared. Lab already making flasks (1 flask shown under Day). Hint explains empty tiles build things and the bin demolishes for half refund. Got it.

My tap on the farm opened the Momo panel instead (Momo was standing there). It shows Momo already looks after 3 tiles: Farm, Farm, Research lab (numbered 1,2,3). 104 jobs, farm skill 3. Nice, it auto-included new buildings. Reading the third letter.
3/3 flasks now - Field expansion ready. Note: the tile numbers seem to be the Momo's visit order, they renumbered. Starting research ($20, 20s).
Harvested farms by hand while Momo does research. One Momo can't keep up with 3 buildings - curious what Hire costs.
Lv3 and Field expansion researched (Crops +1). Hire Momo costs $90, I have $54. More sea to buy at $40. I'll save for a second Momo. Meanwhile, what is 'Next: City 0/4' at top-left?

Status panel: island is 'Momonium', a Village. To become a City: Land 5/9, Momo 1/3, Research levels 1/3, Value produced $156/$1.5K. Clear goals now - more land, more Momos, more research. Checking the Store tab.
Store tab is just an inventory: crops sold as picked $3 each, research notes 3/30. I have $90 - hiring a second Momo now.

Hired a second Momo named Mochi - it walked straight to the research lab and got auto-assigned there ('Manager may move'). Feels nice that it picked a job on its own. Letting time run to gather notes.

Two research options unlocked: Watering efficiency ($40, 1m30s, wait after water -25%) and Bigger harvests ($60, 2min, Crops +1). Bigger harvests sounds like more money - starting it. $108 now, income +$108/min.
Bigger harvests researching (2 min). $84. Buying the $40 sea tile at bottom-left to work toward Land 9.
New land tile with flowers added. Another $40 sea spot appears right after. Now I'll put a third farm on an empty grass tile in the middle.
Mine needs $120 + Wood 10, so wood comes from a Lumberyard ($80). I have $86 - going for the Lumberyard instead of a farm, to open up the mine path.
Lumberyard is up - cute tree with stump and axe. Actions: Fell (4s) and Replant (2s). Felling it by hand.

Got 2 wood. My tap again opened Momo's panel because Momo was standing on that tile - a bit annoying when I want the building. Momo auto-added the Lumberyard to its route. Harvesting the ripe farm myself.
$100, 4 wood, 12 notes. Momo and I are both working the farms. Want a 3rd Momo for the City goal - checking price.
Third Momo costs $145 (price rises). I have $112, saving up. Waiting a bit.
Hired Pomu - took the lumberyard. City goals now 1/4 (Momo 3/3 done). Research and mailbox both have red dots - checking research.
Bigger harvests done (Lv1). Greenhouse and Seed selection unlocked now. I have $46 so Watering efficiency ($40) is the affordable one - starting it for the 3rd research level.
Watering efficiency researching (1m29s). I now have 10 wood - enough for a mine once I hit $120. Reading the waiting letter.
Letter about a Tree nursery - accepting. Income up to $173/min, I have $129 and 14 wood - time to build a Mine on an empty tile.
Build menu up, Mine is now affordable ($120 + 10 wood, I have $197 / 16 wood). Building it!
Mine is under construction on the front-right tile (7 sec). It took the spot with the bush. Waiting to see it.
Mine done - a lovely little cave with a minecart. Already got 1 stone. Digging by hand.
Pomu moved herself to the mine and my tap selected her again. 2 stone now, $198. With the last seconds I'll buy another land tile toward Land 9.
Watering efficiency finished - City goals now 2/4 (research levels done). Bought the $55 land tile. Income $203/min. Out of time - I'd happily keep going toward the City.
